title: Debt-to-Income (DTI) Ratio Calculator: Check Your DTI Fast
description: Free debt-to-income ratio calculator: add your monthly debt payments and gross income to see your DTI percentage and how much room you have under your own target.
lead: Lenders look at how much of your pay already goes to debt. Enter your gross monthly income and your monthly debt payments to see your debt-to-income ratio and how it compares with a target you choose.
keywords: how to calculate debt to income ratio
what is a good debt to income ratio

sources.title: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau: What is a debt-to-income ratio? Why is the 43% debt-to-income ratio important?
